description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the VacancyRestController in the OrangeHRM recruitment backend. It contains tests for GET requests handling, as well as for unimplemented methods like PUT, POST, and DELETE on the controller, ensuring proper exceptions are thrown.

classes.name: VacancyRestControllerTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the VacancyRestController's handling of API requests and exceptions within the OrangeHRM recruitment plugin.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Sets up test fixtures before tests run, populating test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testHandleGetRequest
methods.description: Tests the handling of GET requests by the controller, including different record states and expected exceptions.

methods.description: Ensures that handlePutRequest throws a NotImplementedException.
